changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO configurator_questions (code, question_text, help_text, answer_type, required, sort_order) SELECT seed.code, seed.question_text, seed.help_text, seed.answer_type, TRUE, seed.sort_order FROM ( SELECT 'BUSINESS_TYPE' AS code, '¿Qué tipo de negocio tienes?' AS question_text, 'Nos ayuda a proponerte un punto de partida. Después puedes quitar o añadir lo que quieras.' AS help_text, 'SINGLE' AS answer_type, 10 AS sort_order UNION ALL SELECT 'MEDICAL_CONSULTATIONS', '¿Qué nivel de atención médica prestas?', 'Si un veterinario ve pacientes y registra diagnósticos, elige al menos «Consultas y vacunación».', 'SINGLE', 20 UNION ALL SELECT 'SELLS_PRODUCTS', '¿Vendes productos, alimento o accesorios?', 'Si tienes mercancía que entra y sale, necesitas inventario.', 'BOOLEAN', 30 UNION ALL SELECT 'CHARGES_AT_COUNTER', '¿Cobras en mostrador?', 'Efectivo, tarjeta o transferencia, con arqueo de caja al cerrar el día.', 'BOOLEAN', 40 UNION ALL SELECT 'TERMINAL_COUNT', '¿Cuántas cajas tienes?', 'Cada punto donde se cobra a la vez.', 'NUMBER', 50 UNION ALL SELECT 'USER_COUNT', '¿Cuántas personas van a usar el sistema?', 'Contando a los veterinarios, auxiliares y a quien esté en recepción.', 'NUMBER', 60 ) seed WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM configurator_questions x WHERE x.code = seed.code);

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO configurator_options (question_id, code, label, sort_order) SELECT q.id, seed.code, seed.label, seed.sort_order FROM ( SELECT 'BUSINESS_TYPE' AS question_code, 'SPA' AS code, 'Spa, baños y estética' AS label, 10 AS sort_order UNION ALL SELECT 'BUSINESS_TYPE', 'CLINIC', 'Clínica veterinaria', 20 UNION ALL SELECT 'BUSINESS_TYPE', 'PETSHOP', 'Tienda de mascotas', 30 UNION ALL SELECT 'BUSINESS_TYPE', 'MIXED', 'Un poco de todo', 40 UNION ALL SELECT 'MEDICAL_CONSULTATIONS', 'NONE', 'Ninguno, solo estética y cuidado', 10 UNION ALL SELECT 'MEDICAL_CONSULTATIONS', 'BASIC', 'Consultas y vacunación', 20 UNION ALL SELECT 'MEDICAL_CONSULTATIONS', 'SURGICAL', 'Además cirugía y hospitalización', 30 UNION ALL SELECT 'MEDICAL_CONSULTATIONS', 'FULL_DIAG', 'Además laboratorio e imagen diagnóstica', 40 UNION ALL SELECT 'SELLS_PRODUCTS', 'YES', 'Sí, vendo productos', 10 UNION ALL SELECT 'SELLS_PRODUCTS', 'NO', 'No, solo presto servicios', 20 UNION ALL SELECT 'CHARGES_AT_COUNTER', 'YES', 'Sí, cobro en el mostrador', 10 UNION ALL SELECT 'CHARGES_AT_COUNTER', 'NO', 'No, cobro por otro medio', 20 ) seed JOIN configurator_questions q ON q.code = seed.question_code WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM configurator_options x WHERE x.question_id = q.id AND x.code = seed.code);

rollback.sql: DELETE co FROM configurator_options co JOIN configurator_questions q ON q.id = co.question_id WHERE q.code IN ('BUSINESS_TYPE','MEDICAL_CONSULTATIONS','SELLS_PRODUCTS', 'CHARGES_AT_COUNTER');

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: UPDATE configurator_questions q JOIN configurator_options parent ON parent.code = 'YES' JOIN configurator_questions pq ON pq.id = parent.question_id AND pq.code = 'CHARGES_AT_COUNTER' SET q.parent_option_id = parent.id, q.version = q.version + 1 WHERE q.code = 'TERMINAL_COUNT' AND q.parent_option_id IS NULL;

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO configurator_effects (option_id, question_id, catalog_item_id, effect, quantity, priority) SELECT NULL, q.id, ci.id, 'QUANTITY_FROM_ANSWER', NULL, seed.priority FROM ( SELECT 'TERMINAL_COUNT' AS question_code, 'EXTRA_TERMINAL' AS item_code, 50 AS priority UNION ALL SELECT 'USER_COUNT', 'EXTRA_USER', 60 ) seed JOIN configurator_questions q ON q.code = seed.question_code JOIN catalog_items ci ON ci.code = seed.item_code WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM configurator_effects x WHERE x.question_id = q.id AND x.catalog_item_id = ci.id AND x.effect = 'QUANTITY_FROM_ANSWER');
